info.title: Baggage Room Jarvis Read-only API
info.description: Server-to-server integration. GET only. Keys in headers only; unknown filters rejected. All timestamps include UTC Z. Monetary record values are integers in existing stored units, aggregate money uses exact integer strings. No currency conversion. Read-only transactions protect business tables. Financial timestamp tracking begins at migration rollout.

get.summary: Actual gross receipts minus refunds grouped by Tashkent day, branch, currency, exact payment type before pagination; unpaid debt excluded.
get.description: No mandatory date range or hidden truncation: omitted from/to reads the complete current ledger. Pagination applies after aggregation; follow pagination.totalPages for the full report. Per backend process/client, at most 2 sales reports execute and 16 wait FIFO without holding pool connections. Waiting is limited to 5 seconds; queue saturation/expiry returns 503 DATA_UNAVAILABLE. Retry the same page with exponential backoff and jitter. SQL statement timeout remains 8 seconds, transaction timeout 10 seconds. Each page has its own repeatable-read snapshot; reconcile historical periods again after ledger edits. Limits are per process, not a shared replica-wide gateway limit.
